        self.oh = []

        self.ii = []
        self.jj = []
        self.cc = []
        self.ww = []
        self.ww_ = []
        self.m_ = 0
        self.ae = []
        self.dd = []
        self.kk = []
        self.ff = []
        self.n_ = 0
        self.pq = []
        self.iq = []
        self.cnt = 0

    def link(self, o, h):
        self.oo.append(o)
        self.oh.append(h)

    def init(self):
        self.oo = [0] * (1 + self.m_ * 2)
        self.oh = [0] * (1 + self.m_ * 2)
        self.ii = [0] * self.m_
        self.jj = [0] * self.m_
        self.cc = [0] * (self.m_ << 1)
        self.ww = [0] * self.m_
        self.ww_ = [0] * self.m_
        self.ae = [0] * self.n_
        self.dd = [float('inf')] * self.n_
        self.kk = [0] * self.n_
        self.ff = [0] * self.n_
        self.pq = [0] * (1 + self.n_)
        self.iq = [0] * self.n_
        self.m_ = 0

    def link_(self, i, j, c, w):
        self.ii.append(i)
        self.jj.append(j)
        self.cc.append(c)
        self.ww.append(w)
        self.ae[i] = self.link(self.ae[i], len(self.oo))
        self.ae[j] = self.link(self.ae[j], len(self.oo) + 1)
        self.m_ += 1

    def less(self, u, v):
        return self.dd[u] < self.dd[v] or (self.dd[u] == self.dd[v] and self.kk[u] < self.kk[v])

    def i2(self, i):
        i *= 2
        if i > self.cnt:
            return 0
        if i < self.cnt and self.less(self.pq[i + 1], self.pq[i]):
            return i + 1
        return i

    def pq_up(self, u):
        i = self.iq[u]
        j = i // 2
        while j > 0 and self.less(u, self.pq[j]):
            self.pq[self.iq[self.pq[j]] = i] = self.pq[j]
            i = j
            j = i // 2
        self.pq[self.iq[u] = i] = u

    def pq_dn(self, u):
        i = self.iq[u]
        j = self.i2(i)
        while j > 0 and self.less(self.pq[j], u):
            self.pq[self.iq[self.pq[j]] = i] = self.pq[j]
            i = j
            j = self.i2(i)
        self.pq[self.iq[u] = i] = u

    def pq_add_last(self, u):
        self.pq[self.iq[u] = self.cnt + 1] = u
        self.cnt += 1

    def pq_remove_first(self):
        u = self.pq[1]
        v = self.pq[self.cnt]
        if v != u:
            self.iq[v] = 1
            self.pq_dn(v)
        self.iq[u] = 0
        self.cnt -= 1
        return u

    def dijkstra(self, s, t):
        self.dd = [float('inf')] * self.n_
        self.dd[s] = 0
        self.pq_add_last(s)
        while self.cnt > 0:
            i = self.pq_remove_first()
            k = self.kk[i] + 1
            for o in self.oo[self.ae[i]:]:
                h_ = self.oh[o]
                if self.cc[h_] > 0:
                    h = h_ >> 1
                    j = i ^ self.ii[h] ^ self.jj[h]

                        self.dd[j] = d
                        self.kk[j] = k
                        self.ff[j] = h_
                        self.pq_up(j)
        return self.dd[t] != float('inf')

    def trace(self, s, t):
        while t != s:
            h_ = self.ff[t]
            h = h_ >> 1
            self.cc[h_] -= 1
            self.cc[h_ ^ 1] += 1
            t ^= self.ii[h] ^ self.jj[h]
        return 1

    def edmonds_karp(self, s, t):
        for h in range(self.m_):
            i = self.ii[h]
            j = self.jj[h]
            self.dd[j] = min(self.dd[j], self.dd[i] + self.ww[h])
        for h in range(self.m_):
            i = self.ii[h]
            j = self.jj[h]
            self.ww_[h] = self.ww[h] + self.dd[i] - self.dd[j]
        f = 0
        while self.dijkstra(s, t):

            for h in range(self.m_):

        for h in range(self.m_):
            cost += self.ww[h] * self.cc[h << 1 | 1]
        return -cost
